title: The Condemned Cavern
logline: An elderly miner refuses to vacate her hollowed asteroid dwelling after habitat officials fabricate structural fatigue reports to clear the sector for luxury executive docks.

roles.description: A retired drill operator who spent fifty years carving her home into native asteroid bedrock; proud, stubborn, refuses to be relocated.
The district development director; polished, defensive, under heavy pressure from offshore developers to deliver vacant berths.
An enforcement agent contracted to serve eviction writs and weld containment bulkheads across non-compliant dwellings.
A luxury station development firm acquiring low-income mining sectors for high-margin private yacht slips.
A sprawling hand-carved habitat module deep in the asteroid strata, filled with antique hydroponics and mining memorabilia.
The administrative appeals office on the station concourse where property condemnations are officially stamped.

public_situation: Notices of immediate emergency condemnation are posted across Sector Nine, citing catastrophic structural fractures in the asteroid bedrock.
private_truth: {role:housing_adjudicator} falsified the acoustic stress logs to condemn {role:cavern_residence} so {role:expansion_syndicate} can build private berthing.

beats.public_change: Bailiffs erect barricades around the cavern sector, cutting primary atmospheric recycling to force residents out.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to deploy seismic acoustic probes through her cavern walls and record true bedrock density readings.
missions.private_fact: She found the corporate surveyor's forgotten calibration beacon left inside her water cistern three weeks ago.

beats.public_change: {role:private_bailiff} arrives with heavy cutting teams, threatening to weld the cavern airlock shut in three hours.

missions.reason: She needs heavy hydraulic airlock bracing jacks bought from station industrial suppliers and brought to her berth to block the welders.
missions.private_fact: She spent her entire terminal miner pension to buy the bracing equipment.

beats.public_change: The final eviction deadline expires as {role:housing_adjudicator} prepares to sign the demolition certificate at {role:adjudication_chamber}.

missions.reason: She needs the verified seismic proof delivered directly into the public registry hearing before the adjudicator signs the demolition warrant.
missions.private_fact: {role:housing_adjudicator} is authorized to offer the pilot thirty thousand credits in developer stock to misplace the data slate.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands in the hearing chamber with the proof that the bedrock is solid. Three parties want the outcome.

options.label: Enter the true seismic survey into public records to cancel the eviction
Sell the seismic core to the developer for an executive slip voucher
Force the adjudicator to grant the resident a lifelong tenancy guarantee in exchange for silence

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the true seismic survey and exposes the fraud.
resolutions.summary: The true seismic data enters the public record. The condemnation is revoked, {role:housing_adjudicator} is removed, and {role:tenacious_resident} keeps her home.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an asteroid dwelling was structurally solid, halting a corrupt developer from evicting a retired miner.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the developer payoff and suppresses the survey.
resolutions.summary: {role:expansion_syndicate} demolishes the home to build private yacht berths. {role:tenacious_resident} is forced into transit dormitories, and property values soar.

consequences.public_summary: Word leaked that a pilot took developer kickbacks to help bulldoze an old miner's bedrock home for private docks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blackmails the adjudicator into granting private lifetime tenancy.
resolutions.summary: {role:tenacious_resident} is granted lifelong immunity from eviction, but adjacent mining families are cleared out anyway without public protest.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the contract or fails the delivery runs.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs breach the airlock and vent the cavern. {role:tenacious_resident} is evicted under armed guard, and corporate construction begins.

loose_threads.detail: The development registry records an advance bonus paid to the structural inspector from an offshore account owned by {role:expansion_syndicate}.
The condemned safety report relies on acoustic frequencies recorded in an entirely different asteroid cluster five hundred light-seconds away.
The demolition order posted on the airlock bears the official signature of an inspector who resigned from station service six months ago.

radio_hooks: Station administration defends condemnation of Sector Nine, citing 'geological instability'.
Protests erupt at {role:adjudication_chamber} over rapid expansion of luxury yacht slips.
Retired miners rally outside Sector Nine airlocks in solidarity with evicted residents.

voice_direction.tenacious_resident: Craggy, slow, and completely immovable. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who has lived fifty years in hard rock, spitting contempt at polished bureaucrats.
voice_direction.housing_adjudicator: Defensive, rapid, and strained. Constantly cites building regulations and civic progress to drown out any mention of who actually profits from the redevelopment.
